qualifiers: Source-level actions are first-class historical research records even when locally reported or no longer practised.
Not every seasonal folk action is a Catholic custom. Folk acts remain with explicit religious-context uncertainties.
Source page checks were made only on named spot pages; others are based on the already indexed Weiser source labels and locators.
Multiple labels from same passage can be distinct or variants; no merger is authorized here.
